name: Unidentified flat-headed frog-like species
description: A frog-like sentient species with green skin and a flat dome-shaped head existed in the galaxy. The species had two bulging yellow eyes with large black pupils, and scattered bumps on their head. They also had a thin long pink mouth that stretched to both sides of their face. The aliens had two thick legs and two thin arms that ended in three fingers and a thumb, with the tips of each colored orange.
